decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanEnergy Statement Design and Access and Planning Statement1133_020 Rev P21133_010 Rev P21133_011 Rev P21133_001 Rev P21133_200 Rev P21133_101 Rev P21133_100 Rev P2Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Prior to occupation, the covered and secured cycle parking, as indicated on the approved plans ref: 1133_100 Rev P2 shall be installed and ready for use. They cycle parking shall be maintained as such thereafter.Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking in line with the Council's adopted standards.

Prior to occupation of the development, the refuse store as set out in drawing ref: 1133_100 Rev P2 shall be provided on site and available for use. The refuse store shall be retained and maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.Reason: In order to facilitate efficient, safe and clean removal of household refuse, the location and accessibility of refuse storage plus to maintain safety on the Highway.

Notwithstanding the provisions of classes A, B, C, D, E and F of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any amending Order), no enlargement, improvement, alteration, buildings, extensions or enclosure to the existing and new buildings hereby approved shall be carried out or erected without the prior approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the area and ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and to prevent the overdevelopment of the site

Notwithstanding the submitted Energy Statement, the development hereby approved shall not be occupied until a revised Energy Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The revised Energy Statement shall demonstrate that the residential units hereby approved achieve a minimum 35% reduction in CO"² emissions above the levels required by Building Regulations Part L 2021. Details confirming compliance with the approved Energy Statement, including photographs, copies of installation contracts, as-built SAP worksheets, and any other relevant verification documents, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation of the development. The submitted details shall demonstrate that the development has achieved a minimum 35% reduction in CO"² emissions above the levels required by Building Regulations Part L 2021.The approved energy efficiency measures shall thereafter be retained and maintained in accordance with the approved details unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets are met in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD49, DMD50 and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

Prior to first occupation of the residential unit hereby approved, the applicant shall submit to and obtain written approval from the Local Planning Authority of a Final Energy Statement (or SAP/SBEM compliance report) demonstrating that the development has achieved a minimum 35% reduction in CO"² emissions beyond the requirements of Building Regulations Part L 2021. The approved energy efficiency and low carbon measures shall be fully installed prior to first occupation and shall be retained permanently.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO"² emission reduction targets are met, in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD49, DMD50 and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014)

The development must achieve reduced water consumption through the use of water efficient fittings, appliances and recycling systems to result in consumption equal to or less than 105 litres per person per day.Reason: To promote water conservation and efficiency measures in all new developments and where possible in the retrofitting of existing stock in accordance with Core Policy 21 of the Core Strategy and the London Plan.
